cost_protocol.non_identification: A ratio of ad spend to attributed subscriptions estimates a conditional attributed event cost, not incremental causal acquisition, long-run profit or an YPP-qualified subscriber.
cost_protocol.incremental_effect_study: Would require predeclared matched or randomized comparable channels or users (when permitted), matched windows and organic controls, accounting for seasonality, uploads and other promotion.
cost_protocol.uncertainty_scope: No representative campaigns, selection probabilities, attribution windows or returns are yet observed

rules: Paid video views, TrueView billable ad views, public playback starts and organic follow-on view events are not interchangeable.
Attributed paid subscribers cannot satisfy the YPP subscriber minimum; observed organic follows may qualify according to current rules.
Campaign impressions, attributed subscribers, website clicks and paying customers have distinct units and conversion stages.
Do not treat advertising budget as actual spend or typical spend; record transactions, currency and dates when available.
No observational count proves an incremental causal effect without valid counterfactual controls.
Only source and analyze a creator's campaign performance with their permitted authorization; do not publish private campaign or buyer records.
2027 announced YPP rule changes and 2026 Promote rules should be date-scoped before claims about eligible watch hours or Shorts.
